usage: tr retrieval eval [-h] [--queries QUERIES] [--index INDEX]
                         [--retriever {bm25,dense,hybrid,hybrid+rerank} [{bm25,dense,hybrid,hybrid+rerank} ...]]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --queries QUERIES     labelled queries, one JSON object per line (default
                        evals/retrieval_query.jsonl)
  --index INDEX         index digest or prefix (default: the newest)
  --retriever {bm25,dense,hybrid,hybrid+rerank} [{bm25,dense,hybrid,hybrid+rerank} ...]
                        one or more, one table block each (default bm25)
